content:
maria: Heads-up — sampleapp onboarding CI is red on auth-retry tests after today's typegen regen.
ajay: Repro locally? link to CI job?
maria: CI job #4021: auth-retry.test.js failing — looks like retry behavior changed (only 1 attempt now).
tyler: can you paste the failing output?
maria: ```
FAIL auth-retry.test.js
  Expected 3 retries but got 1
  at Object.<anonymous> (tests/auth-retry.test.js:42:12)
```
ajay: hmm the typegen regendiff shows param/example ordering changed in the generated client, semver checker flagged a minor bump because example ordering affected exported types
sophia: so publish gate blocked? :grimacing:
devex-bot: publish-checker: regen-diff detected in 'ts-sdk' (hash mismatch). Blockers: missing changelog entry for semver-minor changes.
maria: Right — publishflow failed on regendiff. But the immediate issue: sampleapp depends on a client default for auth retry. One SDK changed the default backoff, so behavior diverged.
ajay: Which SDK changed the retry default?
tyler: go-sdk changed retry policy in PR #312 (2024-10-01). ts-sdk didn't pick it up, so now parity is off.
sophia: Can we do a hotfix to revert the go-sdk change or update ts-sdk to match? What's safer for customers?
maria: For onboarding flows we want parity. Easiest short-term is update ts-sdk to match go-sdk behavior. Long term we should keep retries explicit in sampleapp config.
ajay: Note about semver: behavior changes are considered a minor bump. If we change ts-sdk behavior to match, it is a behavior change (minor) and needs a changelog entry. publishflow will block until changelog exists.
tyler: The regendiff root cause: typegen/codegen is non-deterministically ordering examples which affects generated file hashes and triggers semver noise. I can add a stable sort to the generator. That should remove noisy diffs.
sophia: Timeline? We need a passing demo by EOD.
tyler: I'll open a PR with stable-sort in codegen in ~15m and push a regen. If the regen hash matches, the publish gate won't be tripped.
maria: If stable-sort fixes the regen hash and we still need the behavior change, we'll publish ts-sdk with a minor bump and changelog. If we can't get the changelog auto-gen to include the behavior note, we'll add a manual entry.
ajay: Assigning tasks: @tyler — codegen stable-sort PR and regen; @sophia — draft changelog entry and coordinate release; @maria — update sampleapp to be tolerant of retry variance if we need a temporary workaround.
maria: FWIW sampleapp failing assertion: ```expect(client.send(req)).rejects.toThrow('no retries left')``` should be changed to assert on outcome without relying on exact retry count (or read an exposed retryCount).
sophia: Draft changelog text: "Align TypeScript SDK auth retry defaults with go-sdk to restore SDK parity and prevent onboarding flakiness." Any objections?
ajay: :thumbsup:
tyler: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/codegen/pull/789 — adds stable sort and deterministic example ordering tests. Triggering regen now.
devex-bot: CI: regen-and-publish job triggered for thread 1755554321.
maria: Ran regen locally against PR — hash matches upstream now. Pushing test patch for sampleapp to accept new behavior just in case.
ajay: CI rerun in progress...
devex-bot: CI job 4021 rerun started.
tyler: CI passed on the codegen branch. Rerunning the publish-checker.
devex-bot: publish-checker: regen-diff resolved. No blocking regendiffs detected.
sophia: About versioning: if we change ts-sdk behavior to align with go-sdk, policy says it's a minor bump. Do we want v0.13.0 or a patch?
maria: Behavior parity is a correctness/fix so treat it as a minor. We'll release v0.13.0 and include changelog.
sophia: Publishing ts-sdk v0.13.0 now — release notes: "SDK parity: align auth retry defaults with go-sdk; fixes onboarding flaky auth flows."
maria: Sampleapp onboarding tests green after upgrading to v0.13.0. Thanks all.
tyler: Follow-up: add a regen pipeline unit test to assert stable ordering and add a changelog-generation tweak so manual entries are easier for behavior changes.
ajay: Noted. Also add a short doc in devex about semver rules for behavior changes and sampleapp expectations.
maria: Great. Closing this thread — thanks everyone :party:
